issues: No integrity problem. The diff changes one hyperparameter: WINDOW_PATTERN goes from "SSSL" to "L", so every layer uses full-context attention. It does not touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines, the prepare.py import or the evaluation call.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. A one-character pattern "L" is a valid pattern because it repeats across all layers. Full attention costs more per step, so the model fits fewer steps into the fixed 300 s. That is a fair trade-off, not a flaw. Do check that startup plus training still stays under 450 s.

The numbers support rejection. The candidate scored 1.0665 against an incumbent mean of 1.0652, which is 0.0013 worse (lower is better). A negative z fits that direction. The size of -0.215 implies a noise scale of about 0.006, which is large compared with the gap, so a single run is not a clear signal either way.
I can't recompute z exactly because the two individual incumbent runs and the standard deviation used aren't given. I'm reporting null rather than guessing.
